Hi Noah —

Thanks again for taking the time with us last week. We’re moving toward final reference checks for the Senior Inference Engineer role and I wanted to capture two things from you quickly:

1) The two references you authorize us to contact (name, current company, relationship, best email/phone).
2) Whether you’re okay with a 30-min call where we ask about scope, collaboration, and impact.

If you prefer, you can reply with a short intro message we can send to your references — that speeds things up. I’ve attached a short reference call agenda we use (attachment: reference_call_agenda.docx).

Also looping Monica (recruiting lead) and Laura (hiring manager) for scheduling. Monica — once we get contacts from Noah I’ll book the slots (US West friendly).

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sourcer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Quick debrief for the thread owners (captured after the call w/ Dr. Ruiz):

- Overall: Strong technical ownership on latency-sensitive inference; drove a cross-team optimization that reduced p50 latency by ~18% on 99th percentile inputs.
- Collaboration: Positive — worked closely with product and infra; took feedback and executed well.
- Potential concerns: small gap on large-scale orchestration (multi-region autoscaling) — Elena flagged limited exposure there but fast learning curve.

Action items:
- Monica: add notes to Greenhouse and flag for Laura (done).
- Laura: decide if we want a short follow-up question to Michael Chen (peer) about orchestration experience.
- Sean: will reach out to Aisha to get the placement history and confirm Michael’s contact details.

Thanks everyone — I’ll paste the call notes into the candidate record.

—Sean
Senior Sourcer, Redwood Inference
